Job title: Graduate GIS Consultant

Location: Manchester or Southampton

Start Date: September 2027

Joining Tetra Tech as a graduate is more than starting a new job – you’ll become part of our Next Gen Talent development programme, designed to support you as you build your career with us. Alongside hands-on experience and exposure to real projects, you’ll benefit from a structured programme of regular learning, training and development opportunities, helping you grow your technical and professional skills as you progress.

You’ll be supported throughout your development by experienced colleagues, giving you the opportunity to learn, build your network and develop the skills and experience needed for a successful long-term career with Tetra Tech.

Looking to start your career in a role where geospatial data, technical problem-solving and real project delivery come together? Join Tetra Tech and help shape how information is mapped, analysed and used across major sectors.

Purpose & Scope of the Role

Tetra Tech is a leading technical, engineering and environmental consultancy delivering data-driven solutions across water, environment, infrastructure, energy and international development. Our Geospatial team within the Management & Surveying Business Unit works across single and multi-disciplinary projects for clients in sectors including water, defence and nuclear. This graduate role offers varied work across different project locations, technical requirements and sectors, with support from a collaborative team in a global organisation with a strong local presence.

Your Impact in this position

You’ll help turn complex data into clear, usable information for non-GIS users and support project delivery through mapping, analysis and reporting. From maintaining datasets to improving the way we use GIS technology, your work will help raise quality, efficiency and project outcomes.

5 Core Capabilities

Mapping Support
– Respond to mapping requests across the business and produce clear, accurate outputs.

Data Analysis & Reporting
– Source, prepare and analyse data to create graphics, metrics and reports.

Digital Tools & Applications
– Use Survey123, Dashboards and Insights to build internal applications that support client delivery.

Dataset Management
– Capture, update and maintain datasets for internal and external use.

Project Support & Collaboration
– Assist on data-heavy projects and support the wider GIS team as needed.

GIS Improvement
– Help develop our use of GIS technology, including new tools and approaches to improve quality and efficiency.

Training, Qualifications & Experience

You’ll need a minimum 2:1 BSc in GIS, environmental sciences or geographical sciences, plus knowledge of GIS software or equivalent experience. Experience with the ESRI stack, especially ArcGIS Pro, Survey123, Field Maps and AGOL, is highly desirable, alongside strong communication, presentation, organisation and time management skills. Knowledge of UK environmental and Ordnance Survey datasets is also required. Security clearance suitability is essential.

Working Environment

Based in Manchester or Southampton, with hybrid working supported in line with team and project needs. As a graduate role, you can expect to spend more time in the office initially to support learning, collaboration and development, with flexibility available as you grow in the role.

Application Closing Date: 31st October 2026

Assessment Centre to be held: February 2027

About Tetra Tech

Tetra Tech is a leading provider of consulting and engineering services working across the full project lifecycle worldwide. We have a wide range of expertise across our teams, providing a global support network with a personalised approach to client relationships to better understand where we can add value. We provide a collaborative environment that supports individual performance, innovation, and creativity.

We support public and private sector clients on local, national, and international projects to deliver sustainable and resilient solutions. Our operations in the UK, Ireland, and the Netherlands include more than 6,000 employees who are Leading with Science® to solve our clients’ most complex problems.

In alignment with the Equality Act 2010, we will make reasonable adjustments to support candidates and employees requiring additional arrangements. This could include adaptations to work schedules, training approaches, or the physical workspace. Please inform us if you need any accommodations during the recruitment process or in your day-to-day role

jobs.description:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

MITRE’s Model-Based Analytics Department (L144) is looking for qualified applicants to bring their geospatial, machine learning, advanced analytics, and applied research skills to bear on solving problems of critical national importance. MITRE’s diverse work program provides opportunities to apply your expertise and creative thinking in challenging domains such as healthcare, transportation, and national security. Employees may also participate in MITRE’s internal research and development program, which provides funding for innovative applied research that addresses our sponsors’ hardest problems.

Our department is an interdisciplinary department that thrives on having a large toolbox to support data- and model-driven decision making. We value people who can bring diverse and inclusive perspectives. Our department works to solve modeling and analytic problems in the public interest, in partnership with the government. We also actively conduct independent research in areas of interest to our government partners. If you are passionate about being a Data Scientist that specializes in Geospatial Information Sciences, your skill sets align with our capabilities, and you like working in a collaborative, team-oriented environment, we want to hear from you!

Roles & Responsibilities:

The successful candidate for this position is a geospatial data scientist who combines a solid theoretical and technical background with the ability to formulate problems, develop and evaluate solutions, and communicate results. Familiarity with advanced geospatial data science, modeling, and analysis techniques and methods (e.g., supervised and unsupervised machine learning, GeoAI, Geosimulation, patiotemporal graphs) is a plus. Hands-on software development skills are a must. Candidates should have a strong understanding of how to engineer spatial solutions for geospatial systems and architecture in both traditional and cloud computing environments. Lifelong learning and keeping up with the latest research and technologies is an essential part of working in this field.

Roles and responsibilities include:

Support the development of geospatial data science, modeling, analysis, visualization, and engineering deliverables for sponsor projects and programs, internal research and development, and corporate strategic initiatives.
Remain current on open-source, industry, academia, and US Government techniques and tools for geospatial data science, modeling, analysis, visualization, and engineering.
Apply a variety of spatial data science techniques to tackle customer challenges to include geospatial statistics, spatial optimization, spatial pattern analysis, geospatial artificial intelligence, spatial autocorrelation, activity-based intelligence, imagery analysis, remote sensing, and geospatial data visualization approaches.
Build and test geospatial prototypes in MITRE, government, and commercial cloud environments.

Basic Qualifications:

Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 3 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with relevant experience who can immediately contribute at this job step; or equivalent combination of related education and work experience.
Bachelor’s degree in Geospatial Data Science, Geospatial Intelligence, Geographic Information Systems, GeoInformatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or related degree.
Applied experience with common GIS tools, developing geospatial workflows, and visualizations using Python.
Applied experience in spatial analysis and modeling, and ETL of spatiotemporal datasets and managing spatial databases.
Applied experience in the configuration of web-mapping, dashboard applications, and remotely sensed data.
Familiarity with geostatistics, spatial machine learning, geosimulation, or GeoAI, and multispectral and hyperspectral imagery or synthetic aperture radar.
Familiarity working with spatiotemporal data in graph databases, such as ArcGIS Knowledge, Neo4j, or ArangoDB.
Familiarity developing web applications with common libraries, e.g. OpenLayers, Leaflet, ArcGIS JS API.
Familiarity with geospatial data architectures and spatial database design and management, as well as containerization concepts.
Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret/SCI U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.
This position requires a minimum of 3 days on-site.
